fn SumOfCommonDivisors(a: Int, b: Int) -> Int
  requires (a > 0)
  requires (b > 0)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures forall d in 1..(a + 1): ((not ((((1 <= d) and (d <= b)) and ((a % d) == 0)) and ((b % d) == 0))) or (result >= d))
  effects pure
  example (SumOfCommonDivisors(0, 0) == 0)
{
  0
}
